scope: Focused publication and compound-provenance audit for GSE84161/GSE84162. Public metadata, published methods and qualitative engagement narrative only; no expression values, gene effects, signatures, or scores inspected.
stopping_rule: Stop after the associated primary paper, its GEO family records, cited inhibitor papers, one author-hosted primary-paper copy, and the relevant publisher retrieval attempts. This is not an exhaustive literature or compound-identity census.

entries.notes: Full GSE84161 SOFT metadata. Series design states five buffy-coat donors; sample metadata contains six conditions for replicate numbers 1-5; compound names remain TPL2i and MEKi.
Full GSE84162 SuperSeries metadata. It explicitly lists GSE84161 as a SubSeries and GSE84153 as the related neutrophil RNA-seq subseries.
Public CEL archive for 30 GPL570 array samples. Archive integrity was checked by the parent workflow; no probe intensity or gene expression values were interpreted in this provenance pass.
PubMed XML for Senger et al.; title, publication date, DOI, author list, affiliations, abstract, and cited subject metadata.
Crossref DOI record corroborating title, journal, date, authors, DOI, and publisher metadata.

conclusions.associated_primary_study: Senger et al., Science Signaling 2017, PMID 28420753, DOI 10.1126/scisignal.aah4273
conclusions.gse84161_role: Primary human monocyte array subseries of GSE84162
conclusions.tier_for_psc: Tier B biological candidate; separate array-calibration lead; not frozen raw-count eligible; no ETS2-program response computed
conclusions.donor_design: Five stated buffy-coat donors; five complete replicate-number groups; explicit donor identifiers unavailable
conclusions.tpl2i_identity: Unresolved in inspected public records; proprietary status not established
conclusions.meki_identity: Unresolved; cited multi-inhibitor literature does not identify the study compound
conclusions.concentration_discrepancy: GEO design 2.8 uM TPL2i and 0.31 uM MEKi versus article Fig. 2D 926 nM TPL2i and 103 nM MEKi
conclusions.engagement: Published qualitative pERK1/2 engagement in primary monocytes; no GEO ELISA result file inspected
conclusions.code: Custom R/Bioconductor methods described; no public original code repository located
conclusions.remaining_source_check: Publisher supplement/Table S1 and any explicit Genentech compound disclosure would be needed to resolve chemical identity and concentration mapping
